readings.Aries: Someone is ready to follow your lead. Be worth following. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Taurus: Comfort is not the same as safety. The distinction matters today. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Gemini: The restlessness you feel is signal, not noise. What is it pointing at? The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Cancer: The shell is not the whole organism. Let someone see the rest. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Leo: Someone is asking to be celebrated. You are good at this. Do it without making it about yourself. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: The flaw you keep returning to is not the problem. The returning is the problem. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Libra: The equanimity you project is partly real and partly effort. Let someone see the effort. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: Something you decided a long time ago is governing today. It may not still be correct. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Sagittarius: The map is useful. The territory is better. Go off-map today. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Capricorn: You've been serious for a long time. Levity is not the same as not taking things seriously. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Aquarius: You've been talking about changing something for long enough that the talking has become a substitute for changing. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: Your relationship with reality is flexible by nature. Today, anchor to something concrete. The first instinct was right.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
